title: Behavioural regression tests raising backend coverage toward 100%
user_story: As the owner I want every backend module exercised by behavioural tests so regressions are caught before release (target 90-100%).

requirements.description: New behavioural tests cover the least-covered modules (launcher, isolated CLI, config, system/tools/harness/intelligence API, Hermes provider and adapter, research jobs, routing, schema, PaperOrchestra dispatch, ChatGPT gateway edges, remote compute, project context) through real code paths; external processes/network only replaced at module boundaries.
A malformed legacy harness graph (non-list nodes/edges) is reported as a failed graph, never a server error.
Any PDF extraction failure for a selected reference keeps the reference metadata in the conversation context instead of failing the request.

nonfunctional: No production file excluded from coverage
inputs: Test fixtures in disposable data folders
acceptance_criteria: Malformed harness graph returns status failed

scenarios.expected: Bundle run completes with receipt and results.zip
Broken PDF keeps metadata with extraction error

recovery: Revert the test files; TASK-COVERAGE-662, max three cycles.
test_environment: Real app/services on disposable project folders; Docker, vendor CLIs, network and model back ends replaced at module boundaries.

tdd.scope: RED: 2 ERROR on 28101de (harness 500, PDF stream error). GREEN: 100/100 PASS.
